landing.eyebrow: Trust & safety for the deepfake era
landing.title: Spot fake and intimate images. Act before the legal deadline.
landing.subtitle: Forged Media Detection checks images for signs of AI editing and for explicit content, sends anything uncertain to a trained person, and keeps a countdown on every complaint so it's handled in time. Every decision is sealed, so it can be checked later.

preview.label: What a moderator sees
preview.human: A person makes the final call

paths.title: Start where you are
paths.subtitle: Pick the option that describes you. Each one takes you straight to the right place.

victim.title: An image of me was shared
victim.body: Report it in about two minutes, without an account. You get a case number and PIN to follow up.

checker.title: I want to check an image
checker.body: See whether a photo shows signs of AI editing, or check it against known abusive images without it leaving your device.

moderator.title: I review content
moderator.body: Work through a queue sorted by legal deadline, with keyboard shortcuts, undo and one-click evidence reports.

platform.title: I run a platform
platform.body: Call one API from your upload pipeline to get a decision, scores and a traceable ID for every image.

verifier.title: I need to verify something
verifier.body: Check a labelled image's history, or confirm an evidence report hasn't been changed since it was issued.

how.title: How it works
how.subtitle: The same five steps for every image, whether it comes from an upload, a platform or a report.

in.title: An image comes in
in.body: Uploaded for a check, sent by a platform through the API, or reported by the person in it.

check.title: Two independent checks
check.body: One model looks for signs of editing or AI generation. A separate one checks for explicit content. A fingerprint is made so copies can be recognised later.

route.title: The rulebook picks the route
route.body: Fixed thresholds allow it, send it to a person, or block it. Nothing uncertain is decided by the machine alone.

act.title: A person acts, against the clock
act.body: Complaints carry the legal deadline for their country. Moderators decide, with 10 seconds to undo, and the reporter is told what happened.

seal.title: Sealed and traceable
seal.body: Each result gets a traceable ID and a labelled copy. Evidence reports are digitally signed, so any later change shows.

why.title: Fakes take minutes to make. The harm lasts much longer.
why.body1: A convincing fake image can now be made in minutes. When it's an intimate image of a real person, the harm grows with every hour it stays online.
why.body2: The law now sets the pace: India's IT Rules 2026 require action on these complaints within hours, and the US Take It Down Act within 48 hours. Platforms have to find these images, decide fairly, act on time, and prove what they did.

points.find: Find fakes, including newer AI-generated ones
points.decide: Decide fairly, with a person in the loop
points.act: Act within each country's legal deadline
points.prove: Prove what was done, with sealed records

different.title: What makes it different
different.subtitle: Most tools do one of these jobs. This platform connects them into one workflow.

rows.newFakes: Spots new fakes it has never seen before
rows.known: Recognises copies of known abusive images
rows.routing: Routes every image, with a person for uncertain cases
rows.reporting: Lets affected people report and track without an account

different.footnote: Columns describe typical approaches, not specific products.

numbers.title: Measured on this build
numbers.latency: median time to check an image
numbers.models: independent models look at every image
numbers.undo: seconds to undo any moderator decision
numbers.checked: images checked on this instance so far
numbers.caveat: Accuracy figures come from small evaluation runs and are shown with their caveats on the dashboard. Detecting the newest AI-generated images is an active research area, not a solved problem.

privacy.title: Built to protect the people in the images

noStore.title: No images kept
noStore.body: Images are checked and then discarded. Only fingerprints, scores and decisions are stored.

onDevice.title: On-device check
onDevice.body: "Check before you post" makes the fingerprint in your browser. The photo never leaves your device.

consent.title: Ethical training data
consent.body: The models are trained and tested only on research datasets of consenting actors.

human.title: People decide
human.body: The system acts alone only when it's very sure. Everything else goes to a trained person.

final.title: Ready when you are
final.body: No account is needed to check or report an image.
